item.title: Suntex and Windward Marina Group Merge Marina Portfolios | Boating Industry
item.description: Suntex Marina Investors LLC, through a joint venture with Centerbridge Partners, L.P., recently merged with Windward’s marina portfolio, a Florida-based marina network. The transaction adds 13 marinas and more than 3,000 slips, bringing the Suntex network of marinas to more than 100 nationwide, including 34 locations across Florida.

item.title: Boating Industry 2026 Top Products | Boating Industry
item.description: Entries are now open for Boating Industry's 2026 Top Products! To be considered, products must have been introduced or significantly updated since January 1, 2025.

item.title: The Blueprint for Superyacht Management Excellence: Lessons from the 53.8m Mariotti Persefoni | Boating Industry
item.description: The 53.8-metre motor yacht Persefoni — built by Mariotti Yachts in 2012 and extensively refitted in 2023 — stands as a compelling example of how expert management transforms a charter vessel into a consistently high-performing, professionally presented asset.

item.title: Chelan Bay Marina Opens for 2026 Season on Lake Chelan | Boating Industry
item.description: Seattle Boat Company returns to Lake Chelan for the second season of Chelan Bay Marina, reopening on May 15 and continuing to offer a more boutique, experience-focused approach to time on the water.

item.title: OMAYA Yachts Announces Exclusive UAE Partnership with BB Yachts Agency | Boating Industry
item.description: Bulgarian luxury catamaran manufacturer OMAYA Yachts has entered into an exclusive partnership with BB Yachts Agency as its official representative in the United Arab Emirates and broader GCC region.

item.title: Stingray Boats Partners with Make-A-Wish South Carolina | Boating Industry
item.description: Stingray Boats recently partnered with Make-A-Wish South Carolina. The partnership made its public debut on March 14 at Wild Dunes Resort, where Stingray Boats helped grant the wish of 16-year-old Rutlee, who received a camo 15-foot G3 Gator Tough Jon Boat in a surprise reveal.

item.title: Women in Sailing Conference and Spring Open House in April | Boating Industry
item.description: Narragansett Sailing & Boating School invites sailors and boating enthusiasts from across New England to join two special events celebrating learning, community and the start of the sailing season on April 25 and April 26, 2026 at Cove Haven Marina in Barrington, Rhode Island.

item.title: Yamaha U.S. Marine Names Scott Higgins GM of Marine Engine Systems Sales and Marketing | Boating Industry
item.description: Yamaha U.S. Marine Business Unit recently promoted Scott Higgins to General Manager of Marine Engine Systems Sales and Marketing.

item.title: Pettit Paint and Palinal Announce Partnership Across the Americas | Boating Industry
item.description: Petti Paint, a marine coatings company and a brand of Modern Recreational Technologies, Inc., and Palinal, an Italian coatings manufacturer founded in 1945, recently announced a long-term strategic partnership to accelerate growth in the professional topcoat business throughout the Americas.

item.title: Jason Lent New Harbormaster at St. Andrews Marina | Boating Industry
item.description: St. Andrews Marina Partners (SAMP) and Coastal Marina Management (CMM) of Panama City, FL, recently announced the hiring of Jason Lent as Harbormaster of St. Andrews Marina in Panama City, Florida.

item.description: TopSide Marinas, a family-owned company that acquires and operates marinas around the United States, recently acquired Campbell Point Marina, located on Table Rock Lake in Shell Knob, Missouri.

item.title: Hanson Milone Safe Boating Law to Begin April 1 | Boating Industry
item.description: A new law in Massachusetts will begin on Wednesday, April 1st requiring all motorboat operators to complete a boating safety course.

item.description: Modern connectivity depends on a layered system of infrastructure, including carrier networks, backhaul systems, maintenance cycles, environmental conditions and localized congestion.
